23.title: Works with opus number
23.content: 12 sonatas for two violins and basso continuo, Op. 1 (1705), RV 73 — L'Estravagante; RV 67; RV 61, RV 66 — L'Estravagante; RV 69, RV 62; RV 65, RV 64, RV 75, RV 78, RV 79, RV 63 — L'Estravagante . 12 sonatas for violin and basso continuo, Op. 2 (1709), RV 27, RV 31, RV 14, RV 20, RV 36, RV 1, RV 8, RV 23, RV 16, RV 21, RV 9, RV 32 . L'estro armonico (The Harmonic Inspiration), 12 concertos for various combinations, of which the best known are No. 6 in A minor for violin, No. 8 in A minor for two violins and No. 10 in B minor for four violins, Op. 3 (1711), RV 549, RV 578, RV 310, RV 550, RV 519, RV 356, RV 567, RV 522, RV 230, RV 580, RV 565, RV 265 — Brecon Baroque, Rachel Podger, Bojan Čičić, Johannes Pramsohler, Sabine Stoffer, Alison McGillivray . La stravaganza (The Eccentricity), 12 violin concertos, Op. 4 (c. 1714), 💎 RV 383a, 💎 RV 279, 💎 RV 301, 💎 RV 357, 💎 RV 347, 💎 RV 316a, 💎 RV 185, 💎 RV 249, 💎 RV 284, 💎 RV 196, 💎 RV 204, 💎 RV 298 — Rachel Podger, Arte dei Suonatori . Six sonatas, four violin sonatas and two sonatas for two violins and basso continuo, Op. 5 (1716), RV 18, RV 30, RV 33, RV 35, RV 76, RV 72 . Six violin concertos, Op. 6 (1716–1721), RV 324, RV 259, RV 318, RV 216, RV 280, RV 239 . 12 concertos (two for oboe and 10 for violin), of which three are considered inauthentic: Nos. 1 and 7 (both in B-flat major) for oboe, and No. 9 (in the same key) for violin, Op. 7 (1716–1717), RV 465, RV 188, RV 326, RV 354, RV 285a, RV 374, RV 464, RV 299, RV 373, RV 294a, RV 208a, RV 214 . Il cimento dell'armonia e dell'inventione (The Contest between Harmony and Invention), 12 violin concertos, which include the first four concertos known as Le quattro stagioni (The Four Seasons), Op. 8 (1723), 💎 RV 269, 💎 RV 315, 💎 RV 293, 💎 RV 297 — Anne-Sophie Mutter, Trondheim Soloists; RV 253; 💎 RV 180 — La Serenissima, Adrian Chandler; RV 242 — Il Pomo d'Oro, Dmitry Sinkovsky; RV 332 — Academia Montis Regalis, Enrico Onofri; RV 236; RV 454 — Zefiro, Alfredo Bernardini; RV 362 — Academia Montis Regalis, Enrico Onofri; RV 210 — I Barocchisti, Diego Fasolis, Duilio Galfetti; 💎 RV 178, 💎 RV 449 — La Serenissima, Adrian Chandler . La cetra (The Lyre), 12 violin concertos, all for solo violin except for No. 9 in B-flat major which is for two violins, Op. 9 (1727), RV 181a, RV 345, RV 334; RV 263a — Il Pomo d'Oro, Riccardo Minasi; RV 358, RV 348, RV 359, RV 238, RV 530, RV 300, RV 198a; RV 391 — Il Pomo d'Oro, Riccardo Minasi . Six flute concertos (a second version for recorder was printed in Venice), Op. 10 (c. 1728), RV 433, RV 439, RV 428, RV 435, RV 434, RV 437 . Five violin concertos, one oboe concerto, the second in E minor, RV 277, being known as Il favorito (The Favorite), Op. 11 (1729), RV 207 — Fabio Biondi, Europa Galante; RV 277, RV 336, RV 308, RV 202, RV 460 . Five violin concertos and one without solo, Op. 12 (1729), RV 317, RV 244, RV 124, RV 173; RV 379 — Il Pomo d'Oro, Dmitry Sinkovsky; RV 361 .
